props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Who this is. Without it the avatar is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: initials
props.description: Shown when there is no image, or it fails to load. One or two letters.

props.name: variant
props.description: `subtle` is a tint of the hue; `solid` is its 600 step (400 in dark).

props.name: isDot
props.description: A dot with no number: "something new", not "how many".

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Counts above this show as `maxCount+`.

props.name: isFloating
props.description: Pins the badge to a corner of `children` instead of sitting inline.

props.name: inset
props.description: Indents both ends so the line stops short of its container's edges.

props.name: size
props.description: Line thickness: 1px, 2px, 4px.

props.name: appearance
props.description: uiguideline calls this `variant`; renamed because `variant` means color here.

props.name: startAvatar
props.description: Image URL for a small avatar before the text, e.g. a person in a filter.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. With `isIconOnly`, the icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour by meaning. `accent` is the inverted neutral; `destructive` is for actions that delete or cannot be undone.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Emphasis: `contained` for the main action, `outlined` and `ghost` for the rest.

props.name: size
props.description: 24px (`sm`) or 32px (`md`) tall, from the control tiers. `sm` takes a 12px label.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the content, keeping the width and focus, and blocks clicks. On a link it behaves as disabled.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of its container.

props.name: isIconOnly
props.description: Square, for an icon with no visible label. Requires `aria-label`: a type error without it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native `disabled`: dimmed and out of the tab order. On a link, drops `href`.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Keep it the same in both states: `aria-pressed` carries the state.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the pressed state. Unpressed is always neutral.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Style of the pressed state. Unpressed is `outlined`, or `ghost` when this is `ghost`.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Starting pressed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: size
props.description: 24px (`sm`) or 32px (`md`) tall, as on Button.

props.name: isIconOnly
props.description: Square, for an icon with no visible label. Requires `aria-label`.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a spinner and stops toggling, keeping focus.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of its container.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native `disabled`: dimmed and out of the tab order.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Neither checked nor unchecked: a "select all" with some selected.

props.name: value
props.description: Submitted when checked; "on" by default.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the checked box.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the selected radio.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows a rating rather than asking for one.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Page Up / Page Down and Shift+arrow step.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value (or range) after the label.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled starting state (the spec's `defaultValue`).

props.name: value
props.description: Submitted when on; "on" by default, like a checkbox.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the on state.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow more than one item open at once.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading element each trigger sits in. Match it to the page's outline.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 tag, e.g. `vi-VN`. Defaults to the browser's.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the carousel, e.g. "Featured templates". Required: there may be several on a page.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: Slides in view at once.

props.name: showDots
props.description: Show a dot per slide under the track.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Advance every this many milliseconds. Paused on hover and focus, and never under reduced motion.

props.name: loop
props.description: Previous/next wrap around at the ends.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description:
Keep the closed content in the page as `hidden="until-found"`, so the
browser's find-in-page reaches it and opens it. On by default.

props.name: isSelectable
props.description: Adds a checkbox column.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: 40 (`sm`) or 48px (`md`).

props.name: hasStickyHeader
props.description: Keep the header row in view while the table scrolls inside its container.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Options are still arriving: a spinner, and "Loading…" in the list.

props.name: isClearable
props.description: Show a button that clears the selection.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown in the list when nothing matches.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 tag; decides the typed order (day/month/year) and the calendar's.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Defaults to the locale's pattern, e.g. "dd/mm/yyyy".

props.name: presets
props.description: A list beside the calendars: `true` for the built-in one (Today … Last year), or your own.

props.name: accept
props.description: As the native attribute: extensions and MIME types, e.g. `".pdf,image/*"`. Also checked on drop.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: In bytes.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places shown and accepted.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Options are still arriving: a spinner replaces the chevron.

props.name: resize
props.description: Which way the user can drag to resize. Ignored with `hasAutoSize`.

props.name: hasAutoSize
props.description: Grow and shrink with the content, between `minRows` and `maxRows`.

props.name: minRows
props.description: The starting height, in lines.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: The most it grows to before scrolling, in lines.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at which the task is done. The spec calls it `maxValue`.

props.name: size
props.description: Track height: 4px (`sm`), 8px (`md`) or 12px (`lg`).

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Pill ends on the track and the fill.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the fill. `destructive` for a task that is failing or about to run out, such as storage nearly full.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Progress is happening but how much is unknown: a third of the track slides across.

props.name: showValueLabel
props.description: Shows the percentage after the bar, in tabular figures. Hidden while indeterminate.

props.name: label
props.description: A visible label above the bar; also its accessible name.

props.name: width
props.description: A number is pixels; a string is any CSS length. Fills the container when omitted; a circle is 40px.

props.name: height
props.description: Of the shape, or of each line with `rows`. A single circle ignores it: its height is its width.

props.name: appearance
props.description: The corners: `square`, `rounded`, or a `circle` for an avatar. With `rows`, a circle draws rounded lines.

props.name: rows
props.description: Lines of text: stacked bars 8px apart, the last one at 60%.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of its container, whatever `width` says.

props.name: hasAnimation
props.description: A slow pulse. Off by default: a screen of pulsing shapes is noise.

props.name: size
props.description: The ring: 16px (`sm`), 24px (`md`) or 32px (`lg`) across.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour of the indicator. `accent` is the foreground, as on Button.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before anything shows, so a fast load never flashes a spinner. The live region is there from the start.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Spin even when `value` is given.

props.name: label
props.description: Shown under the indicator, and its accessible name. Without one the name is "Loading", visually hidden.

props.name: maxItems
props.description:
Collapse the middle when there are more than this many: the first item,
"…", and the last `maxItems - 1`. The "…" expands them in place.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown either side of the current one.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at each end.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: The href of the page the reader is on: that item gets aria-current="page".

props.name: isCollapsible
props.description: Show a button that collapses and expands the sidebar.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `underline`: a line under the selected tab. `pills`: a filled segment, for switching views in a toolbar.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Tabs share the full width equally.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: Select a tab as soon as it gets focus, rather than on Enter or Space.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep hidden panels in the DOM, e.g. to preserve their state.

props.name: children
props.default: The card ending in 4242 expires at the end of this month. Update it to avoid an interruption.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: isLive
props.description:
Announce the alert when it appears. `danger` and `warning` interrupt
(`role="alert"`), the others wait their turn (`role="status"`). Leave it
off for an alert that is on the page from the start.

props.name: isLive
props.description:
Announce it when it appears: `danger` and `warning` interrupt
(`role="alert"`), the others wait (`role="status"`).

props.name: timeout
props.description: Default time on screen, in milliseconds.

props.name: limit
props.description: Toasts shown at once; older ones wait.

props.name: size
props.description: Max width: 24rem, 32rem, 48rem. Never wider than the screen.

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: Defaults to `true`, or `false` when `isAlert`.

props.name: isAlert
props.description:
A decision that must be made: `role="alertdialog"`, and a click on the
backdrop does not close it. Pair it with explicit buttons in `footer`.

props.name: closeOnBackdropClick
props.description: Close on a click on the backdrop. Ignored when `isAlert`.

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: A close button in the corner. Escape and a click outside close it either way.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Open on hover as well as click, for previews. Content must still be reachable by click and keyboard.

props.name: isModal
props.description: Trap focus inside while open, lock page scroll and block clicks outside (Base UI's modal mode).

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before it opens. Focus opens it at once.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Never open, e.g. while the trigger's label is already visible.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for a panel or a table body; `md` for a whole page or section.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's heading level, so it fits the page outline it lands in.

props.name: description
props.default: The server didn’t answer. Your projects are safe; try again in a moment.

props.name: isLive
props.description: Announce it when it replaces content that was loading (`role="alert"`).

props.name: description
props.default: 3 people will get an email with a link to join Atlas.

props.name: isLive
props.description: Announce it when it replaces a form or a progress view (`role="status"`).

props.name: navigationLabel
props.description: Names the drawer and its button.

props.name: mainId
props.description: The `id` of the `main` element, which the skip link targets. Generated if not given.

props.name: layout
props.description:
`columns`: term and details side by side, a row each.
`grid`: two columns of term-over-details pairs.
`stacked`: term over details, one after another. Columns fall back to
this on narrow screens anyway.

props.description: Put the list on a card with the header in its top band.
